c1.hasil_ringkas: YOLOv7 dengan delapan bingkai sisi pohon menghitung 133 buah terhadap 130 hitungan manual pada satu pohon (akurasi 97,7%); pada 14 pohon akurasi hitung 95,48%. Model empat sisi hanya menghasilkan 60 buah.

bukti: We strategically selected representative frames from the different segments by capturing a 360-degree video around the tree and splitting it into individual frames to avoid double counting.
At the corner, mangoes will counted twice; to avoid this problem, we used an eight-sided model (Eq. (5)).
FTM is the frame's total mango count, and FCM is the corner mango of the frame.
catatan: Hitungan delapan bingkai dijumlahkan; duplikat dicegah lewat pemilihan bingkai dan pengurangan kelas deteksi 'Corner-Mango' (Pers. 5 tidak terbaca di teks), tanpa pencocokan buah antarbingkai, sehingga dikodekan M0. Naskah menyebut SORT/DeepSORT di bagian metode, tetapi hasil yang dilaporkan berasal dari delapan bingkai diskret, bukan pelacakan. Kelas Hidden/Mango/Corner hanya ditampilkan untuk satu bingkai (Gambar 4), bukan hitungan per kelas pada hasil.

bukti: tracks the position of tomatoes in the image by the spatial displacement information of the robot, while 3D depth filtering can effectively avoid the interference of background tomatoes on the counting
the accuracy rates of bunch and single fruit counting were higher than 84% and 86% respectively

bukti: Point clouds were reconstructed from multi-view images using the structure from motion algorithm.
The developed density-based clustering method could estimate boll counts for this situation, in which bolls were in direct contact with other bolls.
The average accuracy of boll counting was up to 90% and the R2 values between fiber yield and boll number, as well as fiber yield and boll volume were 0.87 and 0.66

bukti: This research aimed to evaluate the potential of VIs and green canopy cover (GCC; as a measure of plant vigour) obtained from conventional (or red, green, blue; RGB) and multispectral sensors
Simple and multiple linear regression techniques were evaluated by using VIs alone, VIs combined with GCC and yield components as predictors.

bukti: Based on the fruit binary map and RGB-D depth image, Euclidean clustering is then applied to group the point cloud into a set of individual fruits.
Quantitative experiments showed that the precision and recall of guava fruit detection were 0.983 and 0.948, respectively; the 3D pose error was 23.43° ± 14.18°
